```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(janitor)
library(here)

sectors <- c(
  "Consulting" = "#264653",
  "Corporate" = "#287271",
  "Federal Government" = "#2a9d8f",
  "Local Government" = "#8ab17d",
  "Non-Profit/NGO" = "#e9c46a",
  "Research/Education" = "#f4a261",
  "State Government" = "#e76f51"
)
```


```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
data <- read_csv(here("data", "meds_2020-26_placement_data.csv")) %>% 

  clean_names() %>% 
  
  # replace "N/A" string with NA value, in placement columns
  mutate(across(initial_placement_job_title:fourth_placement_end_date, ~na_if(.x, "N/A"))) %>% 
  
  # replace "Unknown" string with NA value, in placement columns
  mutate(across(initial_placement_job_title:fourth_placement_end_date, ~na_if(.x, "Unknown")))

sector <- read_csv(here("data", "sectors.csv")) %>% 
  
  clean_names() %>% 
  
  # replace "N/A" string with NA value, in placement columns
  mutate(across(everything(), ~na_if(.x, "N/A"))) %>% 
  
  # replace "Unknown" string with NA value, in placement columns
  mutate(across(everything(), ~na_if(.x, "Unknown"))) %>% 
  
  # remove rows where there was no initial placement/no data (mostly class of 2026)
  filter(!is.na(initial_placement))
```

```{r}
# separate sector df for joining 
initial <- sector %>% 
  select(initial_placement, initial_sector)
second <- sector %>% 
  select(second_placement, second_sector)
third <- sector %>% 
  select(third_placement, third_sector)
fourth <- sector %>% 
  select(fourth_placement, fourth_sector)

# join separate dfs to data (takes a sec)
data <- data %>% 
  left_join(initial, by=c("initial_placement_organization_name" = "initial_placement")) %>% 
  distinct()
data <- data %>% 
  left_join(second, by=c("second_placement_organization_name" = "second_placement")) %>% 
  distinct()
data <- data %>% 
  left_join(third, by=c("third_placement_organization_name" = "third_placement")) %>% 
  distinct()
data <- data %>% 
  left_join(fourth, by=c("fourth_placement_organization_name" = "fourth_placement")) %>% 
  distinct()

# fix missing sector
data <- data %>% 
  
  # Lewis White
  mutate(initial_sector = case_when(
    initial_placement_organization_name == "emLab/Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health" ~ "Research/Education",
    .default = initial_sector)) %>% 
  
  # Sam Muir
  mutate(third_sector = case_when(
    third_placement_organization_name == "Blue Forest" ~"Non-Profit/NGO",
    .default = third_sector)) %>% 
  
  # Nicole Pepper
  mutate(second_sector = case_when(
    second_placement_organization_name == "SkyTruth" ~"Non-Profit/NGO",
    .default = second_sector))

sector <- sector %>% 
  mutate(current_sector = fourth_sector,
         current_sector = ifelse(is.na(current_sector), third_sector, current_sector),
         current_sector = ifelse(is.na(current_sector), second_sector, current_sector),
         current_sector = ifelse(is.na(current_sector), initial_sector, current_sector))
```
```{r}
# add current org as column
sector <- sector %>% 
  mutate(current_placement = fourth_placement,
         current_placement = ifelse(is.na(current_placement), third_placement, current_placement),
         current_placement = ifelse(is.na(current_placement), second_placement, current_placement),
         current_placement = ifelse(is.na(current_placement), initial_placement, current_placement))

# add current sector as a column
sector <- sector %>% 
  mutate(current_sector = fourth_sector,
         current_sector = ifelse(is.na(current_sector), third_sector, current_sector),
         current_sector = ifelse(is.na(current_sector), second_sector, current_sector),
         current_sector = ifelse(is.na(current_sector), initial_sector, current_sector))

# create clean sector df for plotly interactive table
sector_plotly <- sector %>% 
  select(current_placement, current_sector) %>% 
  rename(c(Employer = current_placement, Sector = current_sector)) %>% 
  group_by(Employer, Sector) %>% 
  summarize("# of Alumni" = n())
  
```


```{r}
sector %>% 
  group_by(current_sector) %>% 
  summarize(count = n()) %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(y= reorder(current_sector, -count), x = count, fill = current_sector)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = count),
            color = "white",
            hjust = 1.5) +
  labs(title = "Current (2026) Sector Distribution of MEDS Alumni",
       x = "Number of positions",
       y = " ",
       fill = "Current sector") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sectors)
```

```{r}

# ui set up
ui <- fluidPage(
  
  # easy fix to add some vertical space
  br(), 
  br(),
  
  
  fluidRow(
    column(7, plotlyOutput("bar"), height = "3500px"),
    column(5, h4(textOutput("sector_label")), # sector label above table
      DTOutput("table"))
  )
)

# bar plot

sector_counts <- sector %>% 
  group_by(current_sector) %>% 
  summarize(count = n())

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$bar <- renderPlotly({
    plot_ly(sector_counts, x = ~count, y = ~reorder(current_sector, count), type = "bar",
            color = ~current_sector,
            colors = sectors,
            source = "bar_click",
            text = ~paste0(count, " Alumni"),
            hoverinfo = "text") %>% 
      
           layout(title = "Current (2026) Sector Distribution of MEDS Graduates",
           xaxis = list(title = " ", 
                        range = c(0, 34)),
           yaxis = list(title = "",
                         ticklen = 10,
                         tickcolor = "transparent"),
           showlegend = FALSE,
           height = "3500px"
           # margin = list(t = 150)
 )})
  
# set up clicked output to correspond to sector name
  
  clicked_sector <- reactive({
    d <- event_data("plotly_click", source = "bar_click")
    req(d) # gaurd so that table stays bank until a bar is clicked
    d$y # the sector name lives in the y field of d
  })
 
# sector label heading 
 output$sector_label <- renderText({
  req(clicked_sector())
  clicked_sector()
}) 

# create table  

  output$table <- renderDT({
    req(clicked_sector())
    
     color <- adjustcolor(sectors[clicked_sector()], alpha.f = 0.5)
    
    datatable(sector_plotly[sector_plotly$Sector == clicked_sector(), ] %>% 
    select(-Sector),  # drop it from the table since it's shown above now
    rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = 'rtip',
                                     headerCallback = JS(sprintf(
        "function(thead, data, start, end, display){
          $(thead).find('th').css('background-color', '%s');
        }", color))))
})
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
